name: zed26-gui-c2
description: ZED26 GUI Command and Control System

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.build:go:client-local: go build -tags localtest -o lastfinalversion2_local.exe lastfinalversion2.go lastfinalversion2_localtest.go lastfinalversion2_platform_windows.go lastfinalversion2_platform_other.go
scripts.build:go:client-prod: go build -o lastfinalversion2.exe lastfinalversion2.go lastfinalversion2_platform_windows.go lastfinalversion2_platform_other.go
scripts.build:go:client-linux: set GOOS=linux&& set GOARCH=amd64&& set CGO_ENABLED=0&& go build -o lastfinalversion2_linux lastfinalversion2.go lastfinalversion2_platform_windows.go lastfinalversion2_platform_other.go
scripts.build:go:win-local: npm run build:go:v3 && npm run build:go:client-local

author: ZED26
